_doc: Heat pacts: optional difficulty modifiers chosen at the Covenant (shop id 'covenant'). Each rank adds heat_per_rank heat. effects are per rank: enemy_hp / enemy_damage / enemy_speed / spawn_rate are added multipliers (0.2 = +20%); player_max_hp and ichor_gain are subtracted multipliers (0.15 = -15%). Rewards scale with total heat (Progression.HEAT_SOUL_BONUS etc).

pacts.name: Endless Legion
pacts.description: Heaven sends more of its host. +20% spawn rate per rank.

pacts.name: Righteous Zeal
pacts.description: Faith hardens their flesh. +15% enemy HP per rank.

pacts.name: Wrath of God
pacts.description: Holy blows burn deeper. +15% enemy damage per rank.

pacts.name: Fervent Pursuit
pacts.description: The faithful run you down. +10% enemy speed per rank.

pacts.name: Mortal Frailty
pacts.description: Your vessel weakens. -15% max HP per rank.

pacts.name: Heavy Tithe
pacts.description: Heaven takes its cut. -30% Ichor per rank.
